definitions.explanation: Previously owned items that are resold. A legal and commercial term covering anything from used clothing to electronics.
Old objects valued for their age, craftsmanship, or historical significance. Overlaps with sense 1 but emphasizes the collectible or aesthetic value.

notes:
Composed of {古|こ} (old) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing, object). In everyday use, {古物|こぶつ} straddles two domains: the legal/commercial world of secondhand trading and the cultural world of antique collecting.

In Japan, anyone who buys and sells used goods commercially must hold a ⟦{古物商|こぶつしょう}→古物商：16288_kobutsushou⟧{許可証|きょかしょう} (secondhand dealer's permit) under the {古物営業法|こぶつえいぎょうほう} (Secondhand Articles Dealer Act). This makes the word common in business and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{古物商|こぶつしょう}→古物商：16288_kobutsushou⟧: secondhand dealer; antique dealer
- {古物|こぶつ}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧: antiques market; flea market for used goods
- {古物|こぶつ}⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧: secondhand goods market
- {古物|こぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧: buying and selling of used goods
- {古物営業|こぶつえいぎょう}: secondhand goods business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中古品|ちゅうこひん}→中古品：08302_chuukohin⟧: secondhand item — more everyday, consumer-oriented term for used goods
- ⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧: antique — emphasizes age and artistic/collectible value more than {古物|こぶつ}
- ⟦{廃品|はいひん}→廃品：20482_haihin⟧: discarded goods, junk — items at the end of their useful life, not for resale as-is
